issues.issue: Vanilla and cheese are independently familiar ingredient endpoints. The two real shortest bridges are Poale-n brâu and Pască. Original Andreea recipe and Pain Plaisir product separately use cheese and vanilla in the former; Home Cooking Adventure traditional pasca uses both in the latter. Stored vanilla captions describe ingredient variants rather than an obligatory ingredient in every recipe. Poale-n brâu as cheese-filled Moldavian pastry and pasca as a round cheese/raisin enriched-dough Easter cake fit the displayed identities; modern crustless or raisin-free versions do not invalidate this traditional version. The stored regional church-blessing custom is corroborated by Doxologia describing pasca offered at the night liturgy and municipal documentation of regional Easter baskets. This is a cultural description, not a participation requirement. Public rendered captions still require actual BFF inspection: raw edge text is not assumed to be the visible caption.
